title: PII detector raw score dump
description: Input contract produced by the Swift PII detectors running over the G8 corpus. Consumed by sweep_thresholds.py (Phase 3b). One entry per candidate match (not one per ground-truth span) — Python joins candidates to ground truth by overlap against the G8 corpus annotations.

categories.description: Detector categories present in the dump. Must match the canonical preset_thresholds category order.

documents.description: One entry per G8 document. A document with zero candidates still appears with candidates: [].

candidates.description: Detector-emitted candidates before thresholding. Each candidate is one (category, span) pair with its raw score.

raw_score.description: Detector score in [0, 1] before prior composition and thresholding.

doctype_prior_applied.description: True if the Swift side already composed the A7 doctype prior into raw_score. When false, Python composes the prior. Default: false.
